task_results.prompt: What were the high and low temperatures in Dubai, UAE on February 20, 2026? Report both values in Celsius.
task_results.response_text:
February 20, 2026 is a **future date** — historical weather data for that day doesn't exist yet. Weather services only record observations after they happen, and forecasts beyond ~10–14 days aren't reliable (or even published by most sources).

If you're planning travel or need climate expectations, you'd want **historical averages** for Dubai in late February instead:

| Metric | Typical Late February Range |
|--------|----------------------------|
| **High** | 24–27 °C (75–81 °F) |
| **Low** | 16–19 °C (61–66 °F) |
| **Rain** | Very rare (~1–2 days/month) |
| **Humidity** | Moderate (50–65%) |

For actual conditions closer to your dates, check a reliable forecast 7–10 days out (e.g., [WMO](https://public.wmo.int/), [NCM UAE](https://www.ncm.gov.ae/), or your preferred weather app).
